title: AoE3 Mod Launcher — translations-index.json
description: A list of translation packs published at ANY https address (Google Drive, Dropbox, a gist, a website). Players add the file's link once in the launcher (mod window → Language → Translation sources) and every version listed here shows up for them. Update the SAME file to publish a new version, so the link stays valid. The launcher's Settings → Packager writes it for you ("Add to my index…"). An item that breaks a rule below is skipped by the launcher (and logged), not fatal to the rest.

name.description: What the launcher calls this source, e.g. "Traducciones de Juan". Optional; the host name is used otherwise.

translations.description: One item per VERSION of a pack. Several versions of the same id form one card with a version picker.

id.description: Pack id, the same as the id inside the zip's translation.json (e.g. "ES-LA").

targetMod.description: REQUIRED. The mod id this pack is for (e.g. "wol"). The launcher shows the item only in that mod's window, and refuses a zip whose own translation.json names another mod.

version.description: Pack version. Recommended shape: <mod version>-r<N>, e.g. "1.2.0e-r1".

compatibleWith.description: Mod versions this pack was tested against (exact membership).

zip.description: Download link of the pack's .zip: an https link, or a path relative to this file's address (only when the index is on an ordinary website or a GitHub repo — on Drive, Dropbox or a gist give the full link). Google Drive and Dropbox share links are converted to direct downloads by the launcher; Mega, MediaFire and folder links can't be used.

sha256.description: REQUIRED. SHA-256 of the .zip. Checked before a single byte of the download is used.

contentHash.description: The pack's content hash (the contentHash of its translation.json). Lets the launcher recognise the applied version and avoid duplicate notifications.

date.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp; orders versions newest-first.
